title: Christopher's House
description:
Music City Getaway! 15 minutes from the airport, approximately 25 minutes from downtown Nashville, and 10 minutes from Long Hollow State Park this beautiful home has everything you need and is the perfect place to host family and friends during your stay in Nashville!

The space
Key Features:
This home has two stories. The main level has all of your common areas such as a family room, fully equipped kitchen (Keurig, pots, pans, mixing bowls, dishes, utensils, microwave, toaster, and toaster oven, etc.) and dining room. The family room has a flat screen Smart TV with complimentary Netflix and local channels. The home is located in a quiet cul-de-sac and has a large fenced-in backyard.

Bedrooms:
All bedrooms are upstairs and do not have TVs. The master bedroom has a queen size bed. Two bedrooms have full size beds, and the bonus room has two twin size beds. 

Bathrooms:
The master bedroom has an attached bathroom with a walk in shower and huge tub.
There is an additional full bathroom upstairs and a half bath downstairs. 

Additional Info:
Parking: There is room for 2 cars in the driveway and additional parking in front of the home. There is no access to the garage.

STRP2026.008471

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home (with the exception of the garage) during their stay.

Other things to note
The fireplace is non-working and is for decorative use only.
